snapshot.title: Fleet Grounded — Firmware Review Pending

fields.text: Attention all personnel. All UAS flights are suspended pending investigation. The firmware version 2.3.1, which was pushed to GCS-01 and UAS-02, has been identified as a potential root cause. The fleet status is now updated to: All UAS: Grounded — Firmware Review Pending. No new flights will be approved until further notice.
